selected_evidence.snippet:
Gestational choriocarcinoma is the most common form of gestational 
trophoblastic neoplasm.

assertion.notes: Choriocarcinoma is ICD-O morphology code 9100/3; MONDO:0005207 carries the ICDO:9100/3 cross-reference. This entry previously carried ``Carcinoma`` with a note recording that the enum had no trophoblastic axis value; ``Trophoblastic Tumor`` (NCIT:C3422) was added for exactly this gap and is now assigned. The value covers both forms this entry models - gestational choriocarcinoma and the non-gestational germ-cell form - because NCIT:C3422 is defined as "a gestational or non-gestational neoplasm characterized by excessive proliferation of trophoblastic cells". Where a case is known to be the non-gestational variant, that is a germ cell tumour clinically and is treated as one; the morphology axis is single-valued, so the trophoblastic family is recorded here and the germ-cell reading is left to the entry's prose.
